facts.fact: LDSF describes Anti-Cybercrime Law No. 175 of 2018, including Article 25 on family values, as the law under which authorities prosecute content creators.

LDSF reports the Cairo Economic Court on 29 November 2025 sentenced video blogger Mohamed Abdel Aaty to two years and a fine under the Anti-Cybercrime Law, and sentenced Qamar El-Wekala to six months.
LDSF reports content creators were arrested and sentenced in 2025, including Mohamed Abdel Aaty to two years on 29 November 2025, for charges of harming family values and misusing social media.
